title: SMOK Pink Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid - 20mg
description: Pink Lemonade from SMOK Nic Salts combines the sweet and tangy taste of red summer berries with the zesty, refreshing flavour of lemonade. This e-liquid offers a balanced blend of berry and citrus notes, creating a flavour profile that's both sweet and refreshing SMOK Nic Salt e-liquids are designed to provide a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase nicotine e-liquids. Available in 20mg nicotine strengths, they are perfect for those looking to manage their nicotine cravings efficiently. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid ensures an optimal balance between flavour intensity and vapour production, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with starter kits and pod vape devices. SMOK are renowned for their innovative vaping hardware, producing some of the most iconic and influential vape kits in the world. Now they have expanded their expertise to the e-liquid market with their very own Nic Salts range. These e-liquids are conveniently packaged in 10ml bottles, offering a cost-effective, easy to carry, and environmentally friendly alternative to single-use disposable vapes. If you enjoy the tropical and vibrant taste of Kiwi Passionfruit Guava, explore the other 6 delicious flavours in the SMOK Nic Salts collection. Designed for adult smokers and vapers, this range provides a satisfying vaping experience with each puff.
